dialogues.speaker: Fayez
dialogues.text: Tanger takes his son with him everywhere he goes. The two of them are very close.

dialogues.speaker: Fayez
dialogues.text: Maybe that's why he's able to come up with such great stories.

dialogues.speaker: Fayez
dialogues.text: Anyway, we're counting on you. Please find Tanger for us.

dialogues.speaker: Fayez
dialogues.text: Thank you so much. Here is your compensation, as promised. We hope to see you at Acara Crafts again! We'll offer both of you very generous discounts in the future.

dialogues.speaker: Fayez
dialogues.text: Please let me know if you decide you want to keep the Prototype Aranara, and we'll go get it from the warehouse at once.

choices.text: I'd like to see other carvings.
